description: USE THIS to verify a Belgian National Register Number (Rijksregisternummer / Numéro de Registre National) before relying on it. Checks the 11-digit form and the mod-97 check (handling the born-from-2000 rule). Validates structure only.

nrn.description: The 11-digit Belgian National Register Number (punctuation ignored).

name: validate_be_nrn
